sentences.text: Es sábado por la mañana en Tegucigalpa, la capital de Honduras.
sentences.english: It is Saturday morning in Tegucigalpa, the capital of Honduras.

sentences.text: Karla va al mercado con su madre, doña Reina.
sentences.english: Karla goes to the market with her mother, doña Reina.

sentences.text: En el mercado hay mucha gente.
sentences.english: There are many people at the market.

sentences.text: Hay frutas, verduras, queso y tortillas.
sentences.english: There is fruit, vegetables, cheese and tortillas.

sentences.text: Doña Reina necesita frijoles, plátanos y tomates.
sentences.english: Doña Reina needs beans, plantains and tomatoes.

sentences.text: —Buenos días, doña Reina —dice la vendedora.
sentences.english: "Good morning, doña Reina," says the seller.

sentences.text: —Buenos días —dice doña Reina.
sentences.english: "Good morning," says doña Reina.

sentences.text: —¿Qué desea? —pregunta la vendedora.
sentences.english: "What would you like?" asks the seller.

sentences.text: —Quiero una bolsa de frijoles y seis plátanos, por favor.
sentences.english: "I would like a bag of beans and six plantains, please."

sentences.text: La vendedora pone todo en una bolsa.
sentences.english: The seller puts everything in a bag.

sentences.text: —¿Cuánto es? —pregunta doña Reina.
sentences.english: "How much is it?" asks doña Reina.

sentences.text: —Son cincuenta lempiras, señora —dice la vendedora.
sentences.english: "It is fifty lempiras, ma'am," says the seller.

sentences.text: Doña Reina paga y recibe su cambio.
sentences.english: Doña Reina pays and gets her change.

sentences.text: Después compran tomates y queso.
sentences.english: Then they buy tomatoes and cheese.

sentences.text: Karla tiene hambre y quiere una baleada.
sentences.english: Karla is hungry and wants a baleada.

sentences.text: Una baleada es una tortilla de harina con frijoles.
sentences.english: A baleada is a flour tortilla with beans.

sentences.text: También puede llevar queso.
sentences.english: It can also have cheese.

sentences.text: En una esquina del mercado, una mujer hace baleadas.
sentences.english: On a corner of the market, a woman makes baleadas.

sentences.text: —Una baleada, por favor, señora —dice Karla.
sentences.english: "A baleada, please, ma'am," says Karla.

sentences.text: Karla come la baleada y dice: —Está muy rica.
sentences.english: Karla eats the baleada and says, "It is very good."

sentences.text: Al salir, pasan por la pulpería de la esquina.
sentences.english: On the way out, they pass by the pulpería on the corner.

sentences.text: Doña Reina compra café.
sentences.english: Doña Reina buys coffee.

sentences.text: Con las bolsas llenas, las dos vuelven a casa.
sentences.english: With their bags full, the two of them go back home.
